name: Azariah (son of Oded)
title: Prophet who met King Asa
summary: Azariah, son of Oded, was a prophet upon whom the Spirit of God came. He went out to meet King Asa after a victory and encouraged him to hold fast to the Lord, which led to a great religious renewal in Judah.

keyEvents.title: Encourages King Asa
keyEvents.description: Azariah, son of Oded, spoke prophetically to Asa and urged him to be strong and seek the Lord.
